collection: Cinderella World Variants - ATU 510A Persecuted Heroine
classification: ATU 510A - Cinderella, ATU 510B - Cap o' Rushes (Love like Salt), ATU 511
scholarly_note: Over 700-3000 variants known worldwide per Cox 1893 (345 variants), Ragan 2007 (1000+), and modern estimates up to 3000. Folklorists note Cinderella is most widespread folktale.
oldest_variant: Yeh-Shen China 850 AD, Rhodopis Egypt 1st century BCE as proto

variants.title: Yeh-Shen (Ye Xian) - China - Oldest Known Cinderella
variants.source: Youyang Zazu by Duan Chengshi - Tang Dynasty
variants.full_story: In ancient China, Chief Wu had two wives. One died leaving daughter Yeh-Shen, beautiful and clever at pottery. Her stepmother hated her and made her work in caves gathering firewood and water. Yeh-Shen had only one friend, a fish with golden eyes in a pond, which she fed daily. Stepmother discovered fish, killed it and ate it, hiding bones. An old man from heaven told Yeh-Shen to hide fish bones in her room; whatever she wished would be granted. New Year festival came, stepmother forced her to stay home. Yeh-Shen prayed to bones and was given a cloak of kingfisher feathers and tiny golden slippers. She went to festival, charmed all, but fled losing one slipper when step-siblings chased. A trader from To'han found slipper and presented to king. King searched for owner, trying slipper on all women. Finally Yeh-Shen tried it, it fit perfectly. She wore feather cloak again, king married her. Stepmother and stepsister were stoned to death? Actually they fled and were buried in flying stones in some versions.
variants.ending: Marries king, stepfamily punished by flying stones

variants.title: Rhodopis - Egypt/Greece - 1st Century BCE
variants.full_story: Rhodopis was a beautiful Greek courtesan living in Naukratis, Egypt. One day while bathing, an eagle (actually Horus?) snatched one of her red-rose gilded slippers and flew away, dropping it in lap of Pharaoh Psammetichus in Memphis who was holding court. Pharaoh, struck by small size and beauty of slipper, sent heralds throughout Egypt to find woman to whom slipper belonged. Found Rhodopis, married her, making her Queen of Egypt. Oldest Cinderella-like tale with slipper test.

variants.title: Cenerentola - La Gatta Cenerentola - Italy - Basile
variants.source: Giambattista Basile - Pentamerone - Lo Cunto de li Cunti
variants.full_story: Zezolla is a princess whose governess kills her own mother? Actually Zezolla's father has new wife, her governess becomes stepmother with six daughters. Zezolla is demoted to kitchen, called Gatta Cenerentola (Cat Cinderella) because she tends fireplace. She plants a date tree given by fairy from Crete. Fairy lives in tree and grants wishes. King holds feast. Zezolla asks fairy for dress, goes three nights with different dresses, loses slipper - a patten (slipper) or cioppine. King's servant finds it. King declares woman who fits slipper will be queen. Stepsisters cut feet but doves point blood. Zezolla fits, becomes queen, stepmother punished.

variants.title: Cendrillon ou La Petite Pantoufle de Verre - France - Perrault
variants.source: Charles Perrault - Histoires ou Contes du Temps Passé
variants.full_story: A gentleman's daughter after mother's death suffers under second wife with two proud daughters. She is made to sleep in attic among cinders, called Cinderella (Cendrillon). Father in her shadow. Prince holds ball for two days. Cinderella weeps, her fairy godmother appears, transforms pumpkin into carriage, mice into horses, rat into coachman, lizards into footmen, her rags into beautiful gown of cloth of gold and silver, gives glass slippers (pantoufle de verre - some say vair fur). Warns to leave before midnight when magic ends. Cinderella goes, charms prince, leaves at midnight first night, second night stays till clock strikes twelve, loses glass slipper fleeing. Prince proclaims he will marry woman who fits glass slipper. Stepsisters try to force foot, fail. Cinderella asks to try, fits, produces second slipper, fairy godmother makes her even more beautiful, marries prince, forgives stepsisters and marries them to lords.
variants.ending: Forgives stepsisters, marries them to lords

variants.title: Aschenputtel - Germany - Brothers Grimm
variants.source: Brothers Grimm - Kinder- und Hausmärchen KHM 21
variants.full_story: A rich man's wife dies, tells daughter to remain pious. Man remarries woman with two daughters beautiful but evil. They call stepdaughter Aschenputtel (Ashputtel) because she must sit in ashes. Father goes to fair, asks what to bring, stepdaughters ask fine clothes, Aschenputtel asks first branch that knocks his hat on way home. Father brings hazel branch, she plants on mother's grave, waters with tears, grows into great tree, white bird lives in it granting wishes. King holds three-day festival to find bride. Aschenputtel asks stepmother to go, denied, stepmother throws lentils into ashes task. White birds sort lentils. Aschenputtel goes to tree: 'Shiver and quiver little tree, silver and gold throw down over me.' Bird throws gold and silver dress and silk slippers. She goes to ball, prince dances only with her, she escapes. Three nights, dresses more beautiful each night, third night prince spreads pitch, loses gold slipper. Prince goes house to house, stepsisters cut toe and heel to fit, doves cry 'Rook di goo, blood in shoe!' Finally Aschenputtel fits, doves say she is true bride. At wedding, doves peck out stepsisters' eyes for wickedness.
variants.ending: Stepsisters blinded by doves, harsh punishment

variants.title: Katie Woodencloak (Kari Trestakk) - Norway
variants.full_story: King has daughter Katie, queen dies, king remarries widow with daughter. New queen cruel, Katie flees dressed in wooden cloak (trestakk) with a bull that is her friend. Bull tells her to kill him and take items from his body: cloth, etc. Bull fights dragon? Actually bull fights other bulls for kingdom. Katie works in castle kitchen as Kari Woodencloak. Prince holds church viewing (three Sundays). Katie asks to go, denied, then uses bull's gifts: gets silver dress and horse, goes to church, prince falls in love, she throws golden apple? Actually she is seen. Third time prince puts tar to catch her, she loses one golden boot. Prince finds boot, seeks owner. Katie reveals wooden cloak off, shows she is princess, marries prince.

variants.title: The Sharp Gray Sheep - Scotland
variants.source: John Francis Campbell - Popular Tales of the West Highlands
variants.full_story: A king's daughter whose mother dies, stepmother hates her, has a sharp gray sheep (pet) that helps her. Stepmother kills sheep. Daughter weeps over sheep's grave, bird helps? She goes to church in fine dresses from sheep, loses shoe. Prince finds, marries.

variants.title: Rashin-Coatie - Scotland
variants.full_story: Daughter of gentleman, mother dies, father remarries cruel wife with daughter. Rashin-Coatie is name because she wears coat of rushes. Has red calf that helps. Calf killed by stepmother. Rashin weeps, calf's bones give fine clothes. King holds ball, Rashin goes three nights, loses satin shoe, king finds, marries.

variants.title: Ye Xian alternative - Vietnam / Tam and Cam
variants.full_story: Tam is kind, Cam is cruel stepsister, stepmother hates Tam. Tam has fish pet Bống, stepmother kills it. Buddha-like old woman gives Tam bones magic. Festival, Tam gets beautiful clothes and shoes from magic. Loses shoe, king finds, Tam fits, becomes queen. Stepmother plots, kills Tam making her reincarnate as oriole, fruit tree, loom shuttle, etc., each time Cam kills reincarnation, finally Tam reborn from areca fruit and reunites with king, punishes stepfamily by making them eat tainted food and die.
variants.ending: Stepmother and Cam die after eating poisoned

variants.title: Cinderella - Native American - The Rough-Face Girl - Algonquin
variants.source: Algonquin - recorded by Charles G. Leland
variants.full_story: In a village by lake, a girl is scarred by fire tending fire, called Rough-Face Girl, mocked by sisters. Invisible Being (mighty spirit) lives across lake, his sister guards him, only girl who can see him may marry him. Many girls try, fail to see him. Rough-Face Girl with help of birch tree and magic moccasins, with face washed clean by lake water, sees Invisible Being, wears beautiful clothes, marries him, scars healed.

variants.title: The Baba Yaga and Vasilisa the Beautiful - Russia
variants.full_story: Vasilisa's mother dies, gives doll blessed. Father remarries cruel woman with two daughters who send Vasilisa to forest to get light from Baba Yaga's hut, hoping Yaga will eat her. Baba Yaga tests Vasilisa with impossible tasks: separate wheat, poppy etc. Doll helps. Vasilisa passes, Yaga gives skull lantern with burning eyes. Skull burns stepmother and stepsisters to death. Vasilisa goes to city, weaves fine cloth, Tsar sees cloth, seeks weaver, marries Vasilisa. No slipper but persecuted heroine motif.
variants.ending: Stepmother and stepsisters incinerated, marries Tsar

variants.title: Cap o' Rushes - England
variants.full_story: A man has three daughters, asks how much they love him. Third says as much as salt. Father angry, banishes her. She makes coat of rushes, goes to great house, works as servant Cap o' Rushes. Son of house sees her fine without rush coat when she goes to dance, falls in love. She reveals identity, father who now knows value of salt repents.

variants.title: Catskin - England
variants.full_story: Similar to Cap o' Rushes, but also includes incestuous father who wants to marry daughter because she resembles dead mother, she asks for coat of catskins and flees, works as scullion, marries lord.

variants.title: Nya-chan and the Golden Slipper - West Africa - Ghana
variants.full_story: Nya is orphan mistreated by stepmother, has no shoes. Goes to river, water spirit gives golden slippers that dance. At festival, chief's son sees her dancing, slipper falls in river, chief finds, fits Nya, marries.

variants.title: The Anklet (Chiriya) - India - Punjabi
variants.source: Indian folklore - Sara Dosa? Punjab variant
variants.full_story: A girl has anklet (payal) instead of slipper. Stepmother mistreats. Girl goes to well, fairy gives beautiful anklet. Prince hears anklet sound, follows, finds owner, marries.

variants.title: Cinderella - Persian Variant - Moon-Brow Girl (Mahpishani)
variants.full_story: Girl with moon-like brow mistreated by stepmother, has cow helper, cow killed, bones become tree granting dresses, goes to festival, loses shoe made of almond? Prince finds, marries.

variants.title: Little Saddleslut - Ireland
variants.full_story: Girl called Little Saddleslut because works in kitchen, has hen that lays? Helps? Goes to mass in fine cloak from hen, loses shoe, prince finds.

variants.title: The Turkey Girl - Pueblo Native American - Zuni
variants.full_story: A poor girl tends turkeys, turkeys are magical, give her fine clothes of feathers to go to Dance of Sacred Bird, she loses? Actually she goes to dance, turkeys say return before sun sets or lose magic, she stays too long, turkeys abandon, but boy who saw her finds her, marries.

variants.title: The Cinder Maid - Japan - Benizara and Kakezara
variants.full_story: Stepdaughter called Benizara (red plate) and Kakezara (broken plate), works in kitchen. Has sparrow helper. Sparrow gives magic mallet and dress. Goes to festival, loses geta sandal, lord finds, marries.

variants.title: Cinderella - Disney Modern Variant - 1950
variants.full_story: Retelling of Perrault with added mice Jaq and Gus, fairy godmother song Bibbidi Bobbidi Boo, pumpkin carriage, glass slipper, midnight. Most famous modern version. No foot mutilation, kind ending.

variants.title: Cinderella - Korea - Kongji and Patzzi
variants.full_story: Kongji's mother dies, cruel stepmother Patzzi and stepsister Patzzi? Actually stepmother and daughter. Kongji helped by cow, sparrows, toads. Cow plows field, sparrows sort rice, toads bring water. Festival, birds give dress, loses shoe? Actually governor finds shoe? Fairy helps, Kongji marries governor, stepmother punished: turned into pot? Death by sauce jar.
variants.ending: Stepmother dies by falling into sauce jar or drowned
